release_contents: Recruitment defect remediation pass (Phase 1 of the 2026-09-24 master priority). (1) CV-optional-behaves-required: investigated exhaustively with a real-browser-accurate FormData/fetch reproduction of an untouched empty file input; Laravel/Symfony already correctly treats it as no-file — did NOT reproduce, no code change. (2)+(3) Photo broken in Admin AND PDF: root-caused to TWO independent bugs, both fixed — (a) deploy pipeline never carried storage/app/private/uploads forward on atomic release switch, silently orphaning every previously-uploaded applicant file on each deploy (see release_manager_fix below); (b) views checked photo_path/cv_path DB-column truthiness instead of real file existence, rendering a broken for any orphaned row. New JobApplication::photoFileExists()/cvFileExists() (real Storage::disk('uploads_private')->exists() checks) now gate every render path (admin index/show/print/pdf); a recorded-but-missing file now shows a distinct 'ফাইল পাওয়া যায়নি' warning state instead of a broken image icon. (4) PDF header redesigned: logo exactly once, bilingual org name (bn primary/en secondary), 'স্বেচ্ছাসেবী আবেদনপত্র / Volunteer Application' title, thin divider — resources/views/admin/recruitment/applications/document.blade.php. (5) Laravel error pages (403/404/419/429/500/503) redesigned: small icon mark instead of the full wordmark (was a redundant second org-name announcement), tightened Bengali copy matching the user's exact example wording, added an 'আগের পাতায় যান' (go back) secondary action on 404/403. (6) preferred_contact
release_manager_fix: admin-erp/deploy/remote/release-manager.php's `stage` case now copies storage/app/private/uploads forward from the currently-live app before a new release goes live (same pattern already used for .env), reporting uploads_persisted:{source_existed,dest_file_count} in its result. This fix was manually re-installed to the server's _tooling/release-manager.php BEFORE this deploy's own `stage` step ran (verified via the `install` cron action, uid TF5RmGkJRA, ~2026-09-23T21:52Z) — this deploy's own stage step is the first one that actually exercised it live: uploads_persisted reported source_existed:true, dest_file_count:1, confirming the fix works. Does NOT retroactively recover the 3 real applications (ids 10, 12, 15) whose files were already orphaned by every PRE-fix deploy; those DB rows were deliberately left intact (not deleted — see PROD_DEFECT_REMEDIATION note) and now render the graceful missing-file state instead of a broken image.
